patterns.message: Import design-system components from '@/ds', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:Schibsted Grotesk|Noto Sans KR|Noto Sans JP|JetBrains Mono))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: Schibsted Grotesk, Noto Sans KR, Noto Sans JP, JetBrains Mono.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, color, style.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, children, style.
<Badge> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'pending'.
<Button> variant must be one of 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, action, padding, children, style.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, indeterminate, disabled, label, onChange, style.
<CurrencyChip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: code, rate, asOf, source, style.
<Dialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, message, width, footer, children, style.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, title, action, style.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, style.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Input> align must be one of 'left' | 'right' | 'center'.
<Input> size must be one of 'md' | 'lg'.
<ListRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: selected, windowActive, alt, height, onClick, children, style.
<Money> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: amountMinor, currency, size, kind, signed, showCode, muted, minorUnitExponent, style.
<Money> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'hero'.
<Money> kind must be one of 'income' | 'expense' | 'transfer'.
<Popover> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: width, children, style.
<ProgressBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, color, height, style.
<Radio> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, disabled, label, description, onChange, style.
<SegmentedOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label, icon.
<SelectOption> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, label.
<SidebarItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, label, dotColor, trailing, selected, windowActive, indent, onClick, onEdit, onOpen, editLabel, openLabel, style.
<Switch> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, disabled, label, onChange, style.
<Tag> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: color, label, dotOnly, inkLabel, style.

<Tag> color must be a category ink ('groceries' | 'rent' | 'transport' | 'dining' | 'utilities' | 'income' | 'transfer') or a legacy name ('red' | 'orange' | 'yellow' | 'green' | 'blue' | 'purple' | 'gray').
<Toolbar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, leading, children, style.
<Tooltip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, children, style.
